results.title: Remembering in the diaspora: In solidarity with EJK victims
results.content: The artworks open up a conversation about the ongoing stigma and dehumanization faced by EJK victims and their surviving families — even among Filipinos in the diaspora who watched the war on drugs unfold from afar

results.title: [Puso at Diwa] A lost opportunity to test the truth in Sara Duterte’s trial
results.content: The withdrawal of witnesses may be a tactical decision for the defense. But for the Filipino people, it is also a lost opportunity to test the truth.
